mapper.insert: INSERT INTO donation_pot (pot_id, member_id, balance) VALUES (#{potId}, #{memberId}, #{balance})
mapper.update: UPDATE donation_pot SET balance = #{balance}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE pot_id = #{potId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO donation_history (donation_id, pot_id, amount, recipient_name) VALUES (#{donationId}, #{potId}, #{amount}, #{recipientName})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM donation_history WHERE pot_id = #{potId} ORDER BY donated_at DESC
